rows.evaluation_data_html:
Submit the following for FAA review:

  • 1. A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with their treating physician (family medicine, internal medicine, endocrinology) no more than 90 days before the AME exam.

It should include a summary of the history of the condition or diagnosis; current medications, dosages, and side effects (if any); clinical exam findings; results of any testing performed; diagnosis; assessment and plan (prognosis); and follow-up.

  • 2. Lab: Performed no more than 90 days before the AME exam to include
  • Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH), and
  • Any other lab already performed (e.g. T3, Free T4) by the treating physician.
  • 3. Imaging: Copies of any imaging reports (MRI, CT, ultrasound, X-ray) already performed.
  • 4. Any other testing deemed clinically necessary by the treating physician.
  • 5. If previous thyroidectomy, submit operative report, History and Physical, and Discharge summary.
